title: Neon Chess in Surreal Garden
description: A young man in a vibrant blue patterned suit crouches over a glowing, futuristic chessboard set on a cracked floor. He is carefully placing a luminous blue pawn among large pink and yellow flowers, neon tubes, and floating colorful spheres in a surreal, dilapidated hall.
prompt: A young man with dark hair wearing a dark blue patterned suit and colorful pants crouches low while playing chess, carefully moving a glowing blue piece on a futuristic chessboard that floats above a cracked floor. The scene is filled with oversized pink and yellow flowers, glowing neon tubes in purple and blue, and floating colorful spheres in a surreal dilapidated hall with classical arches, vibrant psychedelic colors, highly detailed digital painting
